title: Background cleanup finds worktrees/targets from the task store (OPENAGENTS_TASKS), like Coder
body:
P1.1: `background::Layout` hardcodes `~/.openagents/{worktrees,targets}` while Coder follows `$OPENAGENTS_TASKS`. Derive both from one shared function; test with OPENAGENTS_TASKS set.

From the Paseo worktree gap analysis (docs/worktrees/2026-10-03-paseo-worktree-gap-analysis.md, 61580a0aec), phase 1 (disk).
